items.title: Labcorp (LH) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Q3 Analyst Revisions
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Labcorp Holdings has been adjusted from US$344.25 to US$354.50, a move of about US$10.25 that reflects updated analyst work after the latest Q3 review. External analysts have gone further, with several price targets now between US$380 and US$410, which shows a wider debate around how much upside Labcorp Holdings might support if current assumptions hold.
